memories.text: Aspirin 75mg OD; Atorvastatin 40mg HS; Metoprolol succinate 25mg OD; Isosorbide mononitrate 20mg OD; SL GTN SOS; Methylcobalamin 1500mcg OD; Amlodipine 5mg OD; Telmisartan 40mg OD; Losartan 50mg OD; HCTZ 12.5mg OD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent in ADLs, shops daily, uses public transport. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock normal). falls: 0 falls last 12 months, gait steady, TUG 10s (normal). medicines: 10 regular, polypharmacy, review Beers. mood: denies depression, PHQ-2 0. carers: daughter Priya, supportive. goals: "Stay active and keep running my shop."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 92 mg/dL (optimal <100). Serum vitamin B12 210 pg/mL (low normal 200-900). MCV 88 fL (80-100). Haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (female 12-16). Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, eGFR 68 mL/min/1.73m2. Serum potassium 4.3 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: ECG: sinus rhythm 78 bpm, no ST‑T changes, no Q waves. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No arrhythmia.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Treadmill test (Bruce protocol): exercised 6 minutes, achieved 85% predicted HR, no chest pain, no ST‑depression, BP response normal. Test negative for ischemia.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Transthoracic echocardiogram: LVEF 58%, mild concentric LVH, no valvular stenosis or regurgitation. No wall motion abnormalities. Normal diastolic function.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve felt a bit more tired over the past week, especially after climbing the shop stairs. My sleep is fine, no palpitations or dizziness. I’m worried my B12 might be low again because my legs feel slightly heavy.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 10 June 2025 at 10:00 am with Dr Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: still independent, reports mild fatigue on exertion. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (stable). falls: 0 falls, gait slightly slower, TUG 11s (borderline). medicines: 10 regular, polypharmacy, Beers review advised. mood: PHQ-2 0, denies low mood. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "Keep managing my shop without feeling exhausted."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: LDL 88 mg/dL (target <100). Vitamin B12 190 pg/mL (low). MCV 89 fL. Haemoglobin 12.6 g/dL. Creatinine 0.92 mg/dL, eGFR 65 mL/min/1.73m2. Potassium 4.4 mmol/L.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: ECG: sinus rhythm 80 bpm, no new ST‑T changes, no Q waves. Stable compared to prior.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to cardiology for evaluation of persistent fatigue and borderline TUG, despite negative stress test. Request ECG review, consider ischemia workup. Include recent labs and med list.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Cardiology review: ECG normal, no ischemia. Fatigue deemed non‑cardiac, likely related to mild anemia and deconditioning. Advise graded activity, continue current meds, repeat Hb in 3 months.
